text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the sun was about to set,
I walked back to the dorm with Manhattan Cafe—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san.
Do you have time after this...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
In that case... could you please...
wait for me at the park...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"That picnic table in the back...
I don't think anything will come over there, so..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I will get ready right away... and head over...
Please excuse me for a moment...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: No sooner had she said that than Manhattan Cafe ran off toward the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Does she have something she wants to discuss?
For now, I decided to head to the park.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Following her directions, I waited for Manhattan Cafe at a picnic table deep in the park, and then—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me.
Sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I turned around, Manhattan Cafe was
standing there carrying a rather large bag.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Setting her bag down on the bench across from her,
she takes out item after item
and begins lining them up on the table.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Preparations are complete.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Placed on the table
were several thermal carafes
and a stack of paper cups.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Here's your coffee...
I... brewed it all myself...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This pot... has a light acidity...
and the one next to it... has a deep, lingering bitterness...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This one has... a strong, fruity sweetness...
While that one has... a nice balance of bitterness and acidity...
choice_data_list: You prepared quite a lot for us, didn't you?
You prepared so much for me, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... which coffee would you like to drink...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Which one catches your eye the most...?
Which one looks the most delicious...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer——

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she gazes intently while asking, I feel
a certain intensity radiating from her.
In response to her question, I――――
choice_data_list: I want to try Cafe's favorite flavor
Might as well drink it all!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
My preferences are... not really anything right now...
Um... well...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san...
I'm sorry...
I was... a bit too pushy...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I just...
wanted to know...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's favorite flavor...
Trainer's coffee preferences...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And yet... this is the only way...
I could think of...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I realized that was her intention behind preparing all those different kinds of coffee.
In that case—
choice_data_list: Since we have the chance, let's share what we both like.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer——

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“......Thank you so much.
Yes, please... if you would....”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, we gathered around the coffee they had preparedand shared each other's tastes beneath the night sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after the coffee grew cold,
a lingering warmth remained in our hearts—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't do that...
You'll upset your stomach...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's true that coffee is... delicious, but...
too much of anything is... bad for you...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I've ended up having too much to drink before, too...
So I try to be careful...
That's why you shouldn't drink too much either, Trainer—
choice_data_list: Still, Cafe brewed it for me, so...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“......Thank you so much.
And also—”

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry... I was a little... too forceful...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I just...
wanted to know...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's favorite flavor...
Trainer's coffee preferences...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And yet, doing something like this...
like forcing you into it, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I realized that was her intention behind preparing all those different kinds of coffee.
In that case—
choice_data_list: In that case, let's share what we each like.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer——

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“......Thank you so much.
Yes, please... if you would....”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, we gathered around the coffee they had preparedand shared each other's tastes beneath the night sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking the time to sip coffee little by little
so as not to upset the stomach felt remarkably heartwarming—
